course.title: Building a Memory Layer
course.tagline: The write path is the part the tutorials skip.

levels.title: The Loop
levels.question: How does a system remember at all?
levels.outcome: A CLI assistant that survives process restart, builds its own corpus from conversation, and is visibly broken in seven documented ways.

levels.title: The Write Path in Earnest
levels.question: How does memory stay correct as it grows?
levels.outcome: memlab v0.2: typed memories, entity resolution, deterministic belief updating, salience-driven decay, and budgeted context assembly.

levels.title: Time, Scale, Multiplicity, Trust
levels.question: How does it survive time, scale, multiplicity, and scrutiny?
levels.outcome: memlab v0.3: bi-temporal, multi-agent, governed, benchmarked, with cascade deletion that provably reaches derived data.

tests.definition: cases collected by pytest; functions are `def test_` definitions

lessons.title: Memory Is Not RAG
lessons.objective: Separate the read path over a given corpus from the write path that authors its own.

lessons.title: The Taxonomy That Actually Routes
lessons.objective: Treat working/episodic/semantic/procedural as engineering categories with distinct lifecycles.

lessons.title: Context Is Not Memory
lessons.objective: Explain why a larger context window is not a memory layer: no selection, persistence, or mutation.

lessons.title: Anatomy of a Memory Layer
lessons.objective: Name every component the rest of the course builds. The reference diagram.

lessons.title: Designing the Memory Record
lessons.objective: Choose the fields now that Intermediate will depend on: scope, provenance, event time, confidence.

lessons.title: Naive Extraction
lessons.objective: Pull durable facts from a turn with structured output, and cause your first over-extraction disaster.

lessons.title: Writing Memories Down
lessons.objective: Append-only JSONL with stable ids and idempotent writes; meet the duplicate problem it creates.

lessons.title: Embedding Recall
lessons.objective: Build minimum-viable vector search, framed as one strategy among several.

lessons.title: Retrieval Is Not Enough
lessons.objective: Scope by owner before ranking; meet semantically-close-but-wrong and confidently-stale.

lessons.title: Getting Memories Into the Prompt
lessons.objective: Inject recalled beliefs with attribution, and mark them as beliefs rather than ground truth.

lessons.title: Session Memory vs Long-Term Memory
lessons.objective: Decide what dies at end of session and what gets promoted.

lessons.title: Your First Memory Layer
lessons.objective: Ship memlab v0.1: an assistant that survives restart.

lessons.title: Watching It Fail
lessons.objective: Catalogue the seven failures you now have; each one names the Intermediate module that fixes it.

lessons.title: The Typed Memory Model
lessons.objective: Give each memory type its own schema, lifecycle, and update rule.

lessons.title: Extraction Pipelines
lessons.objective: Stage candidate generation, salience filtering, schema validation, and type routing.

next.title: Precision and Recall on the Write Path

lessons.title: Precision and Recall on the Write Path
lessons.objective: Measure extraction quality and price the compounding cost of over-extraction.

lessons.title: Atomic Memories
lessons.objective: Size a memory so it can be updated later; recognise one that is too big to revise.

prev.title: Precision and Recall on the Write Path

lessons.title: Entities and Aliases
lessons.objective: Collapse 'my wife', 'Sarah', and 'S.' into one canonical node.

lessons.title: Entity Resolution
lessons.objective: Block, score, merge, and un-merge; handle the split problem.

lessons.title: Scopes and Namespaces
lessons.objective: Key memory by user, agent, org, and session — the multi-tenancy substrate.

lessons.title: Deduplication
lessons.objective: Detect exact, near, and semantic duplicates; choose write-time vs read-time dedupe.

lessons.title: Summarization and Compaction
lessons.objective: Build rolling summaries and hierarchical digests without losing the originals.

lessons.title: Semantic Drift
lessons.objective: Bound degradation by re-deriving from anchored originals, never summarizing summaries.

lessons.title: From Episode to Belief
lessons.objective: Promote 'on Tuesday she said X' to 'she prefers X' — and know when that is wrong.

lessons.title: Contradiction Detection
lessons.objective: Separate a genuine contradiction from a legitimate change over time.

lessons.title: ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, NOOP
lessons.objective: See why a free-form LLM UPDATE decision is the largest source of silent memory corruption.

lessons.title: Deterministic Arbitration
lessons.objective: Confine the model to detection and let rules decide, using recency, authority, and explicitness.

lessons.title: Supersede, Never Destroy
lessons.objective: Keep the audit trail that makes bi-temporal modeling possible later.

lessons.title: Why Forgetting Is a Feature
lessons.objective: Justify forgetting on cost, latency, precision, privacy, and coherence.

lessons.title: Salience Scoring
lessons.objective: Combine recency, reinforcement, explicit markers, and retrieval-hit feedback.

lessons.title: Decay and Memory Tiers
lessons.objective: Move memories across scratchpad, working, and long-term tiers under decay and reinforcement.

lessons.title: Forgetting Under a Budget
lessons.objective: Evict, archive, or quarantine within a bounded store, and tune without losing the user.

lessons.title: Scope, Then Rank
lessons.objective: Apply hard filters on owner, type, and validity before any similarity is computed.

lessons.title: Hybrid Ranking
lessons.objective: Fuse semantic, lexical, recency, and salience signals; add diversity.

next.title: The Query Is Not the Last Message

lessons.title: The Query Is Not the Last Message
lessons.objective: Rewrite and expand queries; condition retrieval on intent.

lessons.title: Should I Even Look?
lessons.objective: Choose between always-on retrieval and memory as a tool call.

prev.title: The Query Is Not the Last Message

next.title: Vector Stores for Data That Changes

lessons.title: Vector Stores for Data That Changes
lessons.objective: Handle reindexing, tombstones, and embedding staleness after an UPDATE.

lessons.title: The Underrated Default
lessons.objective: Use SQLite with FTS as a genuinely good memory store.

prev.title: Vector Stores for Data That Changes

lessons.title: Graph Stores
lessons.objective: Model entities and relations; traverse for multi-hop recall.

lessons.title: Hybrid Architecture
lessons.objective: Pick a store per memory type and keep them consistent under write fan-out.

lessons.title: The Packing Problem
lessons.objective: Treat the token budget as constrained selection, not truncation.

lessons.title: Ordering and Formatting
lessons.objective: Price the line format, and check whether ordering by score costs anything.

lessons.title: What Must Never Be Dropped
lessons.objective: Make coverage an invariant of the packer, derived from the question rather than a topic list.

lessons.title: Does This Earn Its Tokens?
lessons.objective: Price every element of the context, including the ones that are not memories.

lessons.title: Two Clocks
lessons.objective: Audit which of the two clocks is actually running; four instants, not two.

lessons.title: Validity Intervals
lessons.objective: Separate when a fact was true from when it was believed, and query both.

lessons.title: Three Temporal Questions
lessons.objective: Route the three temporal questions, and release every filter that assumed now.

lessons.title: Resolving 'Last Week'
lessons.objective: Four classes of relative reference, and the one you must not resolve.

lessons.title: Temporal Knowledge Graphs
lessons.objective: Cascade invalidation through the derivation graph -- the one that actually has edges.

lessons.title: Sleep-Time Compute
lessons.objective: The window is the cost, not the compute -- and the gate that closes it is already computed.

lessons.title: Background Job Mechanics
lessons.objective: Write back only what the job read -- absence means two opposite things.

lessons.title: Reflection and Insight
lessons.objective: Derive higher-order beliefs, and measure that storing them makes the answer worse.

lessons.title: Promotion as a Release
lessons.objective: Measure a consolidation before applying it, and be able to take it back.

lessons.title: Memory Topologies
lessons.objective: Price each shape by what a reader loses -- and by what it leaks.

lessons.title: Provenance and Trust
lessons.objective: Trust the claim, not the claimant -- and flag what cannot be assessed.

lessons.title: Cross-Agent Write Conflicts
lessons.objective: The precedence rule is a threshold -- and above it, recency decides.

lessons.title: Memory Access Control
lessons.objective: Say no to a write, and assert the filter that says no to a read.

next.title: From Facts to a User Model

lessons.title: From Facts to a User Model
lessons.objective: Key the model on attributes, and keep what does not fit.

lessons.title: Behaviour as Memory
lessons.objective: A correction is a labelled negative example, and it always arrives late.

prev.title: From Facts to a User Model

lessons.title: Personalization Without Creepiness
lessons.objective: Split the model by how each attribute is used, and report what was withheld.

lessons.title: Cold Start and Shared Accounts
lessons.objective: Coverage is not knowledge, and one field stands between two people.

lessons.title: Procedural Memory
lessons.objective: Order survives by exception, and a comment about a workflow parses as one.

lessons.title: Learning From Outcomes
lessons.objective: The conclusion survives and the evidence does not -- measured from the transcript.

lessons.title: Retrieving Procedures
lessons.objective: A workflow loses to a comment about it, and no ranker tuning fixes that.

lessons.title: PII on the Write Path
lessons.module_title: Privacy, PII, Deletion & Right to Be Forgotten
lessons.objective: Label personal data without deciding at the gate -- the strict policy breaks the exam.

lessons.title: Redaction and Minimization
lessons.module_title: Privacy, PII, Deletion & Right to Be Forgotten
lessons.objective: Coarsen per kind, and measure what each level costs the answer.

lessons.title: Deletion That Actually Deletes
lessons.module_title: Privacy, PII, Deletion & Right to Be Forgotten
lessons.objective: Resolve the request by label, then reach every structure -- and report the zeroes.

lessons.title: Proving You Forgot
lessons.module_title: Privacy, PII, Deletion & Right to Be Forgotten
lessons.objective: Prove a deletion using the content-addressed id, and keep none of the content.

lessons.title: Memory Attacks
lessons.module_title: Privacy, PII, Deletion & Right to Be Forgotten
lessons.objective: Three defences exist, all accidental, and the fourth attack has none.

lessons.title: Why Memory Eval Is Hard
lessons.objective: Count what can be scored at all, before scoring anything.

lessons.title: Component Metrics
lessons.objective: Score the stages -- and debug the metric before believing it about the system.

lessons.title: Build Your Own Harness
lessons.objective: One battery across every profile -- and name what it cannot see.

lessons.title: Regression Testing a Stateful System
lessons.objective: Half the tests pin a measured number -- and a frozen corpus is what makes that affordable.

next.title: LLM as Judge, and Its Failure Modes

lessons.title: LLM as Judge, and Its Failure Modes
lessons.objective: One judgement of three model calls -- and arbitration is never one of them.

lessons.title: Reading Benchmark Claims Critically
lessons.objective: Four questions for any score -- applied to your own claim first.

prev.title: LLM as Judge, and Its Failure Modes

lessons.title: The Write Path Dominates
lessons.objective: Count the calls: the read path makes none, and the write path makes two per turn.

lessons.title: The Latency Budget
lessons.objective: Half the per-turn cost blocks -- and the other half is a model call in a stage called deferrable.

lessons.title: Caching, Batching, Routing
lessons.objective: Two of six tactics do not apply, and routing has two targets rather than one.

lessons.title: Scaling the Store
lessons.objective: Replicate and measure -- retrieval grows linearly, consolidation grows 104x.

lessons.title: The Failure Field Guide
lessons.objective: Five of seven symptoms are ambiguous, so the useful column is the tell.

lessons.title: Memory Observability
lessons.objective: Six answers from the record with no logging, and three that need a read-time write.

lessons.title: Invariants and Drift Detection
lessons.objective: Collect the invariants, label the kind, and stop an outlier moving its own reference.

lessons.title: Migrating Live Memory
lessons.objective: The id hashes identity, not state -- which is why this migration was one phase.

lessons.title: Hardening Pass
lessons.objective: Ship v0.3 with its six open items -- the section that makes the rest checkable.
